item.description: GAC Philippines is putting comfort at the center of its flagship people mover with the GN8 PHEV Executive, a seven-seat plug-in hybrid MPV designed for customers who spend long hours on the road. item.title: Green SM expands electric taxi service to Palembang
item.description: Green SM has launched its all-electric taxi service in Palembang, extending its Indonesian network to a second city in Sumatra after Bandar Lampung. The expansion gives residents of the South Sumatra capital access to Green SM’s zero-emission fleet as the company widens its presence across Indonesia
